runtime_recorded.limitation: Hashes identify the declared artifacts; this verifier does not authenticate their provenance.

clock_domains.native: clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC), used for native ordering and duration bounds.
clock_domains.capture: Python time.monotonic (mach_absolute_time on this macOS), used for capture ordering only.
clock_domains.correlation: Explicit surface_ids and capture ready/all_disposed readbacks join domains. No cross-clock offsets or timestamp inequalities are inferred.

scope: Read-only capture verification; no desktop, process-control, or tmux operations. No recovery is inferred.
